metadata.name: Standard Contract Summarization
metadata.description: Template for summarizing contracts, extracting key terms, obligations, and important dates.
metadata.author: Mimir

parameters.name: contractTitle
parameters.label: Contract Title
parameters.description: Title or name of the contract

parameters.name: effectiveDate
parameters.label: Effective Date
parameters.description: Date the contract goes into effect

parameters.name: focusAreas
parameters.label: Focus Areas
parameters.description: Specific areas to focus the summary on (comma-separated)
parameters.defaultValue: obligations, key terms, deadlines, payment terms

parameters.name: contractText
parameters.label: Contract Text
parameters.description: The full contract text to summarize

parameters.name: additionalInstructions
parameters.label: Additional Instructions
parameters.description: Any additional instructions for the summarization
